name: limit_fill_contour_not_planar
why: THE BOUNDARY IS A PLANAR FACE. IFillPatternFeatureData, Remarks, mark 16384: «Sketch, face, planar curve on a face, or coplanar faces» -- the fill lays out the copies in concentric loops INSIDE a planar boundary. The wall of the hole is the only curved face of the part and the state offers it (planar=false): naming it as the boundary is a mistake that can really be made. The operation refuses it before selecting anything and says to indicate the planar face the hole starts from. The twin is the same step with the top face.

expect.tolerance_why: the diameter is read from CylinderParams, which returns metres
72000 minus pi*4^2*12: the calculation has pi inside
